reason: I already pay for ChatGPT and I post maybe twice a month, so I can't see what three AI 'managers' would do for me that I don't already get. 99 euros a month is another subscription I'd likely cancel after the first month.
objection: I already pay for ChatGPT, what does this add? And what is a 'credit' actually worth - 100 a month could run out on day three for all I know.
